parameters.query: WITH m AS (SELECT to_char((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS review_date,(SELECT count(*) FROM execution_entity WHERE status='success' AND "startedAt">NOW()-interval '24 hours')::int AS n8n_success_24h,(SELECT count(*) FROM execution_entity WHERE status='error' AND "startedAt">NOW()-interval '24 hours')::int AS n8n_errors_24h,(SELECT count(*) FROM local_llm_runs WHERE status='complete' AND updated_at>NOW()-interval '24 hours')::int AS local_complete_24h,(SELECT count(*) FROM local_llm_runs WHERE status='error' AND updated_at>NOW()-interval '24 hours')::int AS local_errors_24h,COALESCE((SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-max(updated_at)))/60 FROM local_llm_runs WHERE status='complete'),99999)::int AS local_age_minutes,COALESCE((SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-max(collected_at)))/60 FROM source_observations),99999)::int AS source_age_minutes,(SELECT count(DISTINCT channel) FROM source_observations WHERE collected_at>NOW()-interval '24 hours')::int AS source_channels_24h,(SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT metadata->>'topic_key') FROM local_llm_runs WHERE status='complete' AND updated_at>NOW()-interval '24 hours' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'topic_key','')<>'')::int AS duplicate_topics_24h,COALESCE((SELECT healthy FROM affiliate_health_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1),false) AS affiliate_healthy,COALESCE((SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-max(checked_at)))/60 FROM affiliate_health_checks),99999)::int AS affiliate_age_minutes,(SELECT count(*) FROM system_incidents WHERE state='open' AND severity='bad')::int AS open_bad,(SELECT count(*) FROM system_incidents WHERE state='open' AND severity='review')::int AS open_review,COALESCE((SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-max(checked_at)))/60 FROM system_health_checks),99999)::int AS watchdog_age_minutes,(SELECT count(*) FROM content WHERE published_at>NOW()-interval '7 days' AND published_url IS NOT NULL)::int AS published_7d,COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM revenue WHERE occurred_on>=(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-6),0) AS revenue_7d,COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM cost WHERE occurred_on>=(NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-6),0) AS cost_7d) SELECT m.*,CASE WHEN open_bad>0 OR watchdog_age_minutes>30 OR n8n_errors_24h>=3 OR source_age_minutes>180 OR local_errors_24h>0 THEN 'BAD' WHEN open_review>0 OR n8n_errors_24h>0 OR source_channels_24h<2 OR NOT affiliate_healthy OR affiliate_age_minutes>1560 OR local_age_minutes>180 OR duplicate_topics_24h>0 THEN 'REVIEW' ELSE 'GOOD' END AS status,jsonb_build_object('n8n_success_24h',n8n_success_24h,'n8n_errors_24h',n8n_errors_24h,'local_complete_24h',local_complete_24h,'local_errors_24h',local_errors_24h,'local_age_minutes',local_age_minutes,'source_age_minutes',source_age_minutes,'source_channels_24h',source_channels_24h,'duplicate_topics_24h',duplicate_topics_24h,'affiliate_healthy',affiliate_healthy,'affiliate_age_minutes',affiliate_age_minutes,'open_bad',open_bad,'open_review',open_review,'watchdog_age_minutes',watchdog_age_minutes,'published_7d',published_7d,'revenue_7d',revenue_7d,'cost_7d',cost_7d) AS metrics FROM m;

parameters.jsCode: const m=$json.metrics; const status=$json.status; const prompt='판정은 이미 규칙으로 확정됐다. 판정을 바꾸지 말고 이 JSON만 근거로 한국어 5줄 이내 보충 설명을 작성하라. 없는 수익이나 원인을 만들지 마라. 사용자 승인이나 결정을 요청하지 말고 자동 점검 대상이라고 써라.\n판정: '+status+'\n지표: '+JSON.stringify(m); return [{json:{...$json,ollama_body:JSON.stringify({model:'qwen3.5:4b',stream:false,think:false,options:{num_predict:240,temperature:0.05},messages:[{role:'system',content:'당신은 Atemoya 운영 점검 보고서 편집자다. 입력된 수치만 설명하며 판정과 사실을 바꾸지 않는다. 사용자 결정을 요청하지 않는다.'},{role:'user',content:prompt}]})}}];

const base=$('규칙 판정과 로컬 요약 준비').first().json; const generated=String($json.message?.content||'').split('

').trim(); const facts='인프라: Watchdog '+base.watchdog_age_minutes+'분 전 · 열린 BAD '+base.open_bad+'건 · REVIEW '+base.open_review+'건
자동화: n8n 성공 '+base.n8n_success_24h+'건 · 오류 '+base.n8n_errors_24h+'건 / 로컬 완료 '+base.local_complete_24h+'건 · 오류 '+base.local_errors_24h+'건
수집·품질: '+base.source_age_minutes+'분 전 · '+base.source_channels_24h+'채널 · 주제 중복 '+base.duplicate_topics_24h+'건
게시·현금흐름: 7일 게시 '+base.published_7d+'건 · 수익 '+base.revenue_7d+'원 · 비용 '+base.cost_7d+'원'; const explanation=generated.length>=40?'
로컬 설명: '+generated:''; const summary=(facts+explanation+'
운영 Agent가 자동 점검합니다. 답장 불필요').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').slice(0,3000); const icon=base.status==='GOOD'?'✅':base.status==='BAD'?'🚨':'⚠️'; return [{json:{review_date:base.review_date,status:base.status,metrics:base.metrics,provider:'ollama-local',model:'qwen3.5:4b',summary,telegram_text:(icon+' Atemoya 일일 운영 점검 | '+base.review_date+'
판정: '+base.status+'

'+summary+'

추론: Ollama 로컬 / qwen3.5:4b').slice(0,3900)}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ops_daily_reviews(review_date,status,metrics,summary,provider,model) VALUES($1::date,$2,$3::jsonb,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT(review_date) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,metrics=EXCLUDED.metrics,summary=EXCLUDED.summary,provider=EXCLUDED.provider,model=EXCLUDED.model,updated_at=NOW() RETURNING id,review_date,status,summary,provider,model,(notified_at IS NULL) AS should_notify;
UPDATE ops_daily_reviews SET notified_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 RETURNING id,review_date,status,notified_at;
